steps.text: Build steps show each wire as a line like: #33(GND) -> #31j(LED1.cathode). Read it as: from Pico pin 33 (which is GND) to breadboard hole 31j, in the row of the LED's short leg.
The Pico covers its own pins, so you plug the wire into a free hole in the same row as the pin. Pin 33 is in row 8 on the right side: use hole 8j or 8i. Click one of them.

expect.hint: Find pin 33 (GND / AGND), then go right to the free holes in the same row.
expect.success: Yes. Hole 8j is connected to pin 33 through the breadboard strip.

steps.text: Now the other end: "#31j" means row 31, column j. Click hole 31j.

expect.hint: Rows are numbered along the board, columns a-j across it. Row 31, column j is on the right edge.
expect.success: That's it. 31j shares a strip with the LED's short leg in 31g.
